# Muhammad Aziz Saddique — Systems & AI Hardware Engineer

> Systems & AI Hardware Engineer specializing in IoT hardware, embedded firmware, robotics (ROS 2), and full-stack software development. BS Computer Science graduate from University of Gujrat.

## Core Expertise
- **Hardware & IoT**: ESP32, ESP8266, C++ Firmware, BLE Provisioning, MQTT (TLS), AC Electrical Telemetry (HLW8012, PZEM-004T).
- **Robotics**: ROS 2 Humble, Python, LiDAR SLAM, Kinematics, Autonomous Ground Rovers, Gazebo.
- **Full-Stack & Mobile**: React Native (CLI), React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.

## Key Projects
- [EcoPlugify - Smart Energy Monitoring & Control System](https://frontend-bay-chi-32.vercel.app/projects): 2nd Position Winner at University of Gujrat FYP Competition 2026. ESP32 microcontroller with high-voltage AC relay switching, electrical telemetry, MQTT bridge, and React Native mobile application.
- [Yexon Impex Platform](https://yexonimpex.store/): Enterprise logistics telemetry portal built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Docker.
- [Autonomous Navigation Rover](https://frontend-bay-chi-32.vercel.app/projects): Differential drive mobile robotics platform utilizing ROS 2 nodes, 2D LiDAR point-cloud mapping, and SLAM algorithms.
